mapper.sql: select id, year, month, mould_code,factory_code, mould_status, specifications, pattern, mould_type, ower_factory_code, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by,remark from T_MDM_MOULD_USE_STATUS

select t.id, t.year, t.month, t.factory_code, t.mould_code, t.mould_status, CONCAT_WS('', m.specifications, m.pattern) as specifications_pattern, m.factory_code as ower_factory_code, m.specifications, m.pattern, m.mould_type, t.create_time, t.update_time, t.create_by, t.update_by, t.remark from T_MDM_MOULD_USE_STATUS t left join T_MDM_MOULD_INFO m on t.mould_code=m.mould_code
and t.year = #{year} and t.month = #{month} and t.factory_code = #{factoryCode} and t.mould_status = #{mouldStatus} and t.mould_code like concat('%',#{mouldCode},'%')
and CONCAT_WS('', m.specifications, m.pattern) like concat(#{specificationsPattern},'%')
and (1, t.mould_code) in
(1, #{item})
